extension.description: Minify CSS, JS, HTML and compile SCSS/Sass on save: edit style.css and style.min.css updates itself. Source maps, no build tool needed.
capabilities.untrusted: In an untrusted workspace, minify on save is off and settings that choose output paths or minifier options are ignored. The Minify commands still work.
config.onSave: When saving a file minifies it.
config.onSave.ifMinExists: Only update a .min file that already exists. Create it the first time with 'Minify Current File' or the Explorer menu.
config.onSave.always: Always create or update the .min file.
config.onSave.off: Never on save; only through the Minify commands.
config.languages: File types minified on save and by the folder/workspace commands. 'scss' covers .scss and .sass.
config.exclude: Glob patterns, relative to the workspace folder, never minified on save or by the folder/workspace commands.
config.outputPattern: Where the minified file goes. Variables: `${dir}`, `${name}`, `${ext}` (output extension, `css` for Sass), `${workspaceFolder}`, `${relativeDir}`. A target outside the workspace folder is refused.
config.sourceMap: Write a .map file next to minified JS, CSS and compiled Sass, and point to it with a sourceMappingURL comment.
config.js.terser: Options passed to [Terser](https://terser.org/docs/options/), merged over the defaults. Example: `{ "mangle": false }`.
config.css.cleancss: Options passed to [clean-css](https://github.com/clean-css/clean-css#constructor-options). `level: 2` merges rules more aggressively.
config.html.options: Options passed to [html-minifier-terser](https://github.com/terser/html-minifier-terser#options-quick-reference), merged over the safe defaults.
config.scss.emitCss: When compiling Sass, also write the uncompressed name.css next to name.min.css.
config.scss.loadPaths: Extra folders searched by Sass @use / @import, relative to the workspace folder.
config.statusBar: Show the last minify result in the status bar.
config.maxFileSizeKB: Files larger than this (in KB) are skipped.
